method: verify both release manifests and all archive hashes; re-create pinned features; apply frozen heads/thresholds with no fitting or recalibration; reproduce all prior fold and aggregate metrics exactly
metrics: per repository and pooled per seed: transition counts, old/new calls/pages, positive page-loss counts/sums, negative page-gain counts/sums, zero changes, top10 gains/losses, old/new benefit/harm/tie accounting
concentration: sum of largest1/3/10 positive per-question page increases, divided by total positive increases if nonzero; fixed positive-loss buckets1,2-5,6-20,21+; do not divide by net difference or expose question ids/text/rank rows
invariants: all transitions partition cases; positive increases-negative improvements equals new pages-old pages; unchanged call decisions imply identical ranks/pages; pooled records reproduce2948 questions and published metrics for both seeds
scope: post-hoc diagnostic on already observed development data; no independent final evidence, threshold changes, new model, HF weight release or deployment gate relaxation
replay: full aggregate report byte-identical; synthetic boundary/sign/topK/transition tests
next_decision: use measured concentration and direction of changed calls to distinguish missing beneficial retrieval from added harmful retrieval before choosing another intervention
